purpose: Player asset handoff seam for the clean Unity rebuild. Missing entries intentionally use safe temporary fallbacks.
rules: A supplied prefab must include a visible Renderer and a Collider when it is intended to block shots or player movement.
Keep the prefab pivot at ground level and apply scale in Blender/Unity before delivery when possible.
Do not embed gameplay scripts in supplied prefabs; RedlineRebuild owns input, combat, waves, and state.
